Title: Install Container Manager

Title: Create dedicated shared folder

Title: Create dedicated service user
Description: Create "moltbot_svc" user with NO admin privileges. Grant Read/Write ONLY on moltbot_data, No Access on all other folders.

Title: Enable SSH temporarily
Description: Enable SSH for initial setup: Control Panel > Terminal & SNMP > Enable SSH. Disable after installation.

Title: Create directory structure via SSH
Description: SSH into NAS and create: /volume1/moltbot_data/config, /volume1/moltbot_data/state, /volume1/moltbot_data/compose. Set ownership to moltbot_svc.

Title: Create docker-compose.yml
Description: Create hardened docker-compose.yml with: security_opt no-new-privileges, cap_drop ALL, read_only true, mem_limit 2g, cpus 2.0, pids_limit 256, bind to localhost only.

Title: Configure environment variables
Description: Set MOLTBOT_STATE_DIR, NODE_ENV=production. Add AI API key (Gemini recommended - free and generous limits vs Claude API costs).

Title: Configure DSM Firewall
Description: Enable firewall: DENY Docker subnet (172.30.0.0/24) to LAN (192.168.x.x), ALLOW Docker to internet port 443, ALLOW local machine to NAS:18789.

Title: Disable external access
Description: Disable DDNS for Moltbot ports. Do NOT port-forward 18789 on router. Access only from LAN.

Title: Deploy via Container Manager
Description: Container Manager > Project > Create. Name: moltbot, Path: /volume1/moltbot_data/compose. Build and deploy.

Title: Run onboarding wizard
Description: Via SSH: docker exec -it moltbot-gateway sh -c "node dist/index.js onboard". Set gateway token and AI provider.

Title: Access Control UI and configure
Description: From LAN computer: http://landino-nas:18789/. Paste gateway token. Configure Moltbot internal sandbox (mode: all, workspaceAccess: none).

Title: Verify filesystem isolation
Description: Test that container cannot see NAS files: docker exec moltbot-gateway ls /volume1/ should fail or show nothing.

Title: Disable SSH
Description: Control Panel > Terminal & SNMP > Disable SSH. Re-enable only when needed for maintenance.

Title: Set up Snapshot Replication (optional)
Description: Install Snapshot Replication from Package Center. Take snapshot before first Moltbot run. Schedule daily snapshots of moltbot_data only.

Title: Configure auto-updates (optional)
Description: Add Watchtower container to auto-update Moltbot image daily. Or manually check for updates periodically.

Title: Connect messaging channels
Description: Connect WhatsApp (QR scan), Telegram (bot token), Discord (bot token) via docker compose run --rm moltbot-cli channels commands.

Title: SECURITY: Understand the risks
Description: Docker isolation protects NAS FILES but NOT data flowing through the AI agent. Prompt injection attacks can exfiltrate data via connected channels (WhatsApp, Telegram). API keys stored in container are at risk. This is attack surface on a low-attack-surface device.
